notes_for_editor: Identity is solid: the name, the McNairy County location and the 2014 extant list agree across sources, and the elevation differs by 2 ft (register 645 ft, Landforms 647 ft). The register says only 'Aermotor style', so the model is not stated, and the record's material 'steel' is not confirmed by these sources; the record was not changed. The access level 'private' is an editorial reading of the register's 'appears to be on private property', for human review. No build date, staffing or fire history was found in the sources read. Two searches were used, and no new photos were found.
